about: English glossary for The Last Bell (Posledný zvonec). Binding for every English text (the en column of src/game/localization/*.csv). Human-readable rules: docs/translation/GLOSSARY_EN.md. Built from the live Slovak tables on 2026-10-08; regenerate the sk side when the Slovak tables change. Every mapping is sk -> en; one English rendering per term.

variant.spelling: British (-ise, -our, -re, catalogue, programme, travelled, grey, kerb, tyre)
variant.register: contemporary, natural spoken English; dry, understated humour

typography.dash: spaced en dash ‘ – ’; unspaced in ranges 9–17, 3–2–6

typography.case: sentence case for rooms, hotspots, items, exits, labels and UI; title case for the game title, quest titles and cutscene titles

variant.limits_note: same limits as Slovak (docs/writing/glossary.json → limits); English is usually a little shorter, so a line near the hard limit is a sign of padding
